Hi, Levent,

Thanks for your information.

For STI-21616DGGPM(L2+), the standard PoE budget is 240W because of the PCB
and heat dissipation design.

It will be very troublesome to make it 480W though possible, we need to
change the PCB and enclosure to ensure long-time standard dissipation.

So we do not suggest this.


Another option is,

STI-41616DGGPM or STI-42424DGGPM

It got a bigger enclosure and different PCB design, that can support max
370W output.

The given temperature range is strictly tested(you can find this info in
the datasheet)

Full loading without PoE≤22W

Single power input: PoE power budget≤240W(-40℃~+ 70℃)

Dual power input: PoE power budget≤370W(-40℃~+ 60℃)

*Dual power input must be the same as DC voltage

This is a ready solution.

Because this is a replacement of commercial PoE switch(280W budget) in
light of temperature concerns, 370W is good, right?



Please let me know, then I will send a quotation based on your model choice.

Thank you.
